spec.rawSql: SELECT mydate AS time, COALESCE(NULLIF(title,''), mynote) AS text FROM workout.notes WHERE mydate IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(mydate)
SELECT total_workouts AS "Total Workouts" FROM workout.v_overview
SELECT total_sets AS "Total Sets" FROM workout.v_overview
SELECT total_reps AS "Total Reps" FROM workout.v_overview
SELECT lifetime_volume AS "Lifetime Volume (lb)" FROM workout.v_overview
SELECT total_hours AS "Training Hours" FROM workout.v_overview
SELECT current_bodyweight AS "Current Bodyweight (lb)" FROM workout.v_overview
SELECT streak_weeks AS "Streak (weeks)" FROM workout.v_current_streak
SELECT distinct_exercises AS "Distinct Exercises" FROM workout.v_overview
SELECT period AS time, workouts AS "workouts/wk" FROM workout.v_consistency_week WHERE $__timeFilter(period) ORDER BY 1
SELECT period AS time, workouts AS "workouts/mo" FROM workout.v_consistency_month WHERE $__timeFilter(period) ORDER BY 1
SELECT date_trunc('week', starttime)::date AS time, avg(workout_minutes) AS "avg min" FROM workout.sessions WHERE starttime IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(starttime) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT date_trunc('week', starttime)::date AS time, avg(rest_to_work_ratio) AS "rest/work" FROM workout.v_session_stats WHERE starttime IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(starttime) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT week AS time, volume AS "volume (lb)" FROM workout.v_weekly_volume WHERE $__timeFilter(week) ORDER BY 1
SELECT week AS time, muscle_group AS metric, volume FROM workout.v_muscle_volume_week WHERE $__timeFilter(week) ORDER BY 1
SELECT date_trunc('week', workout_date)::date AS time, avg(reps)::numeric(10,2) AS "avg reps/set" FROM workout.v_sets WHERE is_working AND $__timeFilter(workout_date) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('week', s.starttime)::date AS time, avg(ss.total_reps) AS "reps/session" FROM workout.v_session_stats ss JOIN workout.sessions s ON s.id = ss.session_id WHERE s.starttime IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(s.starttime) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('week', s.starttime)::date AS time, avg(ss.total_sets) AS "sets/workout" FROM workout.v_session_stats ss JOIN workout.sessions s ON s.id = ss.session_id WHERE s.starttime IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(s.starttime) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT workout_date AS time, canonical_name AS metric, max(est_1rm)::numeric(10,1) AS est_1rm FROM workout.v_sets WHERE is_working AND $__timeFilter(workout_date) AND ('${exercise}' = 'All' OR canonical_name = '${exercise}') GROUP BY workout_date, canonical_name ORDER BY 1

spec.title: Estimated 1RM over time  —  $exercise (Epley, best working set/day)

spec.rawSql: SELECT canonical_name AS "Exercise", computed_best_1rm AS "Best est-1RM", heaviest_set AS "Heaviest set (lb)", best_1rm_date AS "1RM date", reported_best_1rm AS "App 1RM", delta_vs_reported AS "Delta" FROM workout.v_prs ORDER BY computed_best_1rm DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT workout_date AS time, canonical_name AS metric, max(weight_lbs) AS "heaviest (lb)" FROM workout.v_sets WHERE $__timeFilter(workout_date) AND (
  '${set_type}' = 'all'
  OR ('${set_type}' = 'working' AND set_type <> 'warm-up')
  OR ('${set_type}' = 'warm-up' AND set_type = 'warm-up')
) AND ('${exercise}' = 'All' OR canonical_name = '${exercise}') GROUP BY workout_date, canonical_name ORDER BY 1

SELECT weight_lbs AS "Weight (lb)", max(reps) AS "Max reps", count(*) AS "# sets" FROM workout.v_sets WHERE is_working AND ('${exercise}' = 'All' OR canonical_name = '${exercise}') GROUP BY weight_lbs ORDER BY weight_lbs DESC

spec.title: Rep PRs — max reps at each weight  —  $exercise

spec.rawSql: SELECT workout_date AS time, canonical_name AS metric, strength_score FROM workout.v_strength_score WHERE $__timeFilter(workout_date) AND ('${bodyweight_lift}' = 'All' OR canonical_name IN (${bodyweight_lift:sqlstring})) ORDER BY 1

spec.title: Strength Score = est-1RM / nearest bodyweight  —  big lifts

spec.rawSql: SELECT mydate AS time, weight_lbs AS "bodyweight (lb)", fat_pct AS "fat %" FROM workout.v_bodyweight WHERE $__timeFilter(mydate) ORDER BY 1
SELECT mydate AS time, chest, arms, waist, shoulders, thighs, calves, neck, forearms, hips FROM workout.v_bodyweight WHERE $__timeFilter(mydate) ORDER BY 1
SELECT movement AS metric, sum(volume) AS volume FROM workout.v_sets WHERE is_working AND $__timeFilter(workout_date) GROUP BY movement ORDER BY 2 DESC
SELECT canonical_name AS "Exercise", lifetime_volume AS "Volume" FROM workout.v_exercise_totals ORDER BY lifetime_volume DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 15
SELECT canonical_name AS "Exercise", days_trained AS "Days" FROM workout.v_exercise_totals ORDER BY days_trained DESC LIMIT 15
SELECT canonical_name AS "Exercise", days_trained AS "Days" FROM workout.v_exercise_totals WHERE days_trained > 0 ORDER BY days_trained ASC LIMIT 15

spec.label: Exercise

spec.rawSql: SELECT canonical_name FROM workout.exercises ORDER BY 1

spec.definition: SELECT canonical_name FROM workout.exercises ORDER BY 1

spec.label: Big lifts (strength score)
